Service however was astonishingly poor on the day. Apparently some staff didn't turn up and even though the place wasn't busy, it was one staff member for the entire resturant. This meant food and service was significantly delayed and some luke warm food served. This isn't the fault of the staff memeber. However we also realised after paying and leaving the venue that the discount applied was incorrect and i have been over charged. Tried emailing and calling to get this resolved with proof of reciept. No answer. Please get in touch with me to resolve! Been nearly 2 weeks now and still unresolved.
